fn zz_generate_v2019_recovery_fixtures() {
    let Some(out) = std::env::var_os("FIXTURE_OUT") else {
        return;
    };
    let out = PathBuf::from(out);
    let copy = |from: &Path, to: &Path| {
        assert!(std::process::Command::new("cp").arg("-a").arg(from).arg(to).status().unwrap().success());
    };
    let seed = |journal: &Path| {
        for id in ["source", "target"] {
            save_entity_identity(journal, id, &json!({"id":id,"name":id}), None).unwrap();
        }
        let facet = journal.join("facets/work/entities/source");
        fs::create_dir_all(&facet).unwrap();
        fs::write(facet.join("entity.json"), br#"{"entity_id":"source"}"#).unwrap();
        fs::write(facet.join("observations.jsonl"), b"{\"id\":1,\"content\":\"met at the park\"}\n").unwrap();
    };

    // An interrupted merge: every phase ran, the source commit never landed.
    let journal = voiceprint_journal();
    seed(&journal);
    copy(&journal, &out.join("merge-before"));
    let error = super::store::with_source_sync_failure(".", || {
        commit_entity_merge(&journal, "source", "target", EntityMergeOptions::default())
    })
    .unwrap_err();
    assert!(error.to_string().contains("source directory sync failure"), "{error}");
    assert!(journal.join("health/entity-merge-recovery/state.json").is_file());
    assert!(!journal.join("entities/source").exists());
    copy(&journal, &out.join("merge-interrupted"));
    fs::remove_dir_all(&journal).unwrap();

    // A committed undo whose cleanup never ran.
    let journal = voiceprint_journal();
    seed(&journal);
    let merged = commit_entity_merge(&journal, "source", "target", EntityMergeOptions::default()).unwrap();
    copy(&journal, &out.join("undo-before"));
    let error = super::store::undo_entity_merge_with_injector(
        &journal,
        &merged.merge_id,
        serde_json::Value::Null,
        Some(&|phase, _| phase == "edges"),
    )
    .unwrap_err();
    assert!(error.to_string().contains("undo committed"), "{error}");
    let state: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(
        &fs::read(journal.join("health/entity-merge-recovery/state.json")).unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(state["source_committed"], true);
    assert_eq!(state["operation"], "undo");
    copy(&journal, &out.join("undo-committed"));
    fs::remove_dir_all(&journal).unwrap();
}
